task: JEE Main PYQ Catalogue Layout & Dark Theme Distinct Cards Blueprint
scope: JEE Main PYQ Catalogue component (/app/frontend/src/features/PyqCatalogue.js) and stylesheet (/app/frontend/src/pyq.css, /app/frontend/src/vibrant-ui.css)
tech_stack: React JS (.js files), Tailwind CSS, Custom CSS (pyq.css, vibrant-ui.css)

problem_summary.issue: Previously, PYQ catalogue required selecting both Year and Date tabs, showing only a single date's papers at a time in a grid.
problem_summary.approved_solution: Remove date tabs/filters completely. When a year is selected, stack ALL papers for that entire year in one continuous vertical list (one below another). Retain shift/date metadata on each card, as well as attempt states (Start, Resume, View Result, Attempt Again).

design_decisions.theme: Dark Theme with Rich Distinct Dark Card Surfaces

year_selector.style: Segmented tab row with high-contrast active states, subtle borders, and glow on active selection.
year_selector.active_state: Blood Red (#D91222) or Crimson accent with subtle inner glow and high-contrast white bold text.
year_selector.inactive_state: Dark surface (#14141C or #1A1A24) with muted text (#B0B0BF) and 1px border (#2A2A38).

paper_cards_layout.container: Single-column flex vertical stack (.pyq-paper-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; })
paper_cards_layout.card_style: Distinct dark color surfaces for each paper card to create visual depth and variety while maintaining legibility in dark mode.

card_typography.title: Date label (e.g. '24 January 2025') as main H2 heading, font-size 1.25rem, weight 800, color #F8FAFC
card_typography.meta: Shift badge, question count, duration, total marks in high contrast with icons
card_typography.actions: View Result (Outline button with ArrowUpRight) and Start/Resume/Attempt Again (Primary Crimson button with ArrowRight/RotateCcw)

css_blueprint.pyq_paper_list: .pyq-paper-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; width: 100%; }
css_blueprint.pyq_dates_removal: .pyq-dates { display: none !important; } /* Date filter bar removed completely */
css_blueprint.pyq_paper_card: .pyq-paper-card { width: 100%; padding: 1.75rem; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card-bg, #14141C); border: 1px solid var(--card-border, #2A2A38); transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; }
css_blueprint.pyq_card_hover: .pyq-paper-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--brand-text, #FF6974); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
css_blueprint.pyq_year_tabs: .pyq-years { display: flex; gap: 0.65rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 1.25rem 0; padding-bottom: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2A2A38); }

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove date tab filter (.pyq-dates) in PyqCatalogue.js and render all papers for the selected year in a vertical flex stack.
Apply distinct rich dark gradient variants to consecutive cards in pyq.css / vibrant-ui.css to make stacked cards visually appealing.
Maintain all existing testids, action links, attempt status indicators, and paper metadata intact.
Do NOT add new features, pagination, or alter other pages.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on overlays, headers, or cards.
